events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Calvin Ridley is making the most of his second chance, in more ways than one.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lawrence, Ridley and defense help Jaguars beat Falcons 23-7 in London

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Stefon Diggs was so elusive on Sunday, the Bills' star receiver even came away with two full cups of beer while celebrating the second of his three touchdown catches.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen throws 4 TD passes, runs for score, Bills rout division rival Dolphins 48-20

events.name: Denver Broncos at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — The Denver Broncos came in reeling from a 50-point blowout and looked like they were headed toward another lopsided loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Russell Wilson throws 3 TDs, Broncos rally from 21 down to top Bears 31-28

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Baltimore was missing two receivers and its starting left tackle, later joined on the sideline by the starting right tackle. Its thin secondary was further depleted when two more defensive backs got hurt.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson has 4 TDs as Ravens roll to 28-3 win over Browns and rookie QB Thompson-Robinson

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — The Tennessee Titans now know what they’re capable of when they're not making mistakes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Henry runs for TD, throws for score as Titans rout Burrow, Bengals 27-3

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Matthew Stafford stumbled, slipped and limped his way through the final 20 minutes of regulation Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford overcomes injury to throw winning TD pass to Nacua in OT to give Rams 29-23 win over Colts

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield might have landed with the right team at the right time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baker Mayfield has 3 TD passes, ailing Derek Carr ineffective as Buccaneers top Saints 26-9

events.name: Washington Commanders at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — A.J. Brown saw more than a spark out of Jalen Hurts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurts throws for 319 yards, Elliott's 54-yarder lifts 4-0 Eagles past Commanders 34-31 in OT

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Minnesota Vikings safety Harrison Smith said he didn't come into Sunday's game expecting to be an integral part of the team's defensive pressure package.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Jefferson's 2 TDs, D.J. Wonnum's 51-yard fumble return lift Vikings over Panthers 21-13

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud has thrown for the second-most yards by a rookie through his first four games in NFL history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud throws for 306 yards, two TDs to lead Texans over Steelers 30-6; Pickett leaves with injury

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — With their $252.5 million quarterback wearing a splint on his non-throwing hand and down three starters on defense, the Los Angeles Chargers found a way to gut out their second straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Khalil Mack's 6 sacks, Justin Herbert's 3 touchdowns propel Chargers to 24-17 win over Raiders

events.name: New England Patriots at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott is getting used to sitting back and watching the Dallas defense do its thing.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys score twice on defense in 38-3 blowout of Patriots, Belichick's worst loss

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — The only person who could stop Christian McCaffrey from tying a San Francisco franchise record with a fifth touchdown was his own coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCaffrey scores 4 TDs to lead the 49ers past the Cardinals 35-16

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs appeared on their way to a blowout against the struggling New York Jets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes, Chiefs hold on to beat Jets 23-20 with Taylor Swift, Aaron Rodgers watching

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at New York Giants

headlines.description: — With all the points the Seattle Seahawks were scoring this season, it was easy to overlook their defense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Devon Witherspoon scores on 97-yard pick-6 as Seahawks' defense leads Seattle over Giants

events.name: Chicago Bears at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Music blared from the Chicago Bears locker room after a victory for the first time in almost a year, and players danced and jumped around with joy.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fields and Moore lead the Bears to their first win of the season, beating the Commanders 40-20

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Whenever Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills tried to rally in the fourth quarter on Sunday, Travis Etienne and the Jacksonville Jaguars had an answer.
headlines.shortLinkText: Etienne runs for 2 TDs and Jaguars beat Bills 25-20 for back-to-back London wins

events.name: Houston Texans at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — All the talk from Atlanta coach Arthur Smith the last two years about Desmond Ridder's poise and composure meant little until the quarterback demonstrated he could shine in the final minute with a game on the line.
headlines.shortLinkText: Desmond Ridder answers critics, Younghoe Koo kicks last-second field goal, Falcons edge Texans 21-19

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions were without arguably their best player and a dynamic rookie on offense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Goff throws 3 TD passes, runs for score, NFC North-leading Lions beat winless Panthers 42-24

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Indianapolis Colts running back Zack Moss heard the talk all week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moss upstages Taylor's return in Colts' 23-16 victory over Titans. Richardson injures shoulder

events.name: New York Giants at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — De’Von Achane’s teammates are learning to brace for a big play each time the rookie running back touches the ball.
headlines.shortLinkText: De'Von Achane and Tyreek Hill lead Miami Dolphins to 31-16 win over New York Giants

events.name: New Orleans Saints at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Alvin Kamara told the Saints coaching staff he wanted to touch the football more this week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kamara becomes Saints' career TD leader, Carr throws 2 TDs in 34-0 rout over Patriots

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — Mike Tomlin spent a portion of the week showing the Pittsburgh Steelers clips of their longtime rivalry with the Baltimore Ravens.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pickett hits Pickens for late touchdown as Steelers rally to stun mistake-prone Ravens 17-10

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Philadelphia went 74 yards in 30 seconds and lined up at the Rams 1 for one final snap before halftime. Just about everybody in SoFi Stadium knew that last play would be the “tush push,” the “Brotherly Shove," or whatever Jalen Hurts' secret name is...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts and a tough defense carry the Eagles to a 23-14 victory over the Rams

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Zac Taylor said he spent much of Sunday's game on the headset with his fellow Cincinnati Bengals coaches, hollering at quarterback Joe Burrow to quit scrambling for a few extra yards and throw the ball away on plays that looked dead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burrow connects with Chase for 3 TDs; Bengals roll past the Cardinals 34-20

events.name: New York Jets at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — For once, Nathaniel Hackett relished Russell Wilson's mistakes and basked in the boos raining down from the stands in Denver.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets rally past Broncos 31-21 with long TD from Breece Hall and scoop-and-score from Bryce Hall

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — Though Patrick Mahomes and the defending Super Bowl champion Kansas City Chiefs have had plenty of scares already, they've lost just one game, by one point.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patrick Mahomes, Chiefs outlast Vikings 27-20; Travis Kelce catches TD pass after hurting ankle

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Brock Purdy and the San Francisco 49ers quickly turned the biggest challenge of their young season into a laugher.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Purdy throws 4 TD passes to lead the 49ers past the Cowboys 42-10

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Linebacker Robert Spillane had just one career interception before Monday night, and cornerback Amik Robertson received just his second start in five games this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders intercept Jordan Love 3 times, hold on to beat Packers 17-13

events.name: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes knows the Kansas City Chiefs' offense is still trying to put everything together.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws TD pass, Kelce has big game with Swift watching again as Chiefs beat Broncos 19-8

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — Lamar Jackson scrambled, evaded tackles and made big throws when he needed to in his international debut.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson throws TD pass and Tucker kicks 6 FGs for Ravens in 24-16 win over Titans in London

events.name: Washington Commanders at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Jamin Davis sensed where the final pass was going before it left the quarterback's hand.
headlines.shortLinkText: Howell throws 3 TD passes, Commanders pick off three Ridder passes in 24-16 win over Falcons

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — The Minnesota Vikings took a cue from the Texas Rangers and decided to play a Creed song. They chose “Higher” and sent Chicago toward another low.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins, Hicks lead way as Vikings knock out Fields, beat Bears 19-13

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — When Joe Burrow couldn't get the ball in the end zone in the second half Sunday, the Cincinnati defense made sure the Seattle Seahawks didn't either.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals defense shuts down Seattle twice late to seal a 17-13 win and improve to 3-3

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — From dominant to defeated — in less than a week. The San Francisco 49ers were reminded there are no perfect teams or givens in the NFL.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns stun 49ers 19-17, hand San Francisco its first loss and QB Brock Purdy his first as starter

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Tyreek Hill knows he has a fine coming for his touchdown celebration in Sunday's 42-21 win over the Carolina Panthers. The NFL’s leading receiver — who caught one of Tua Tagovailoa's three TD passes — said it was worth it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tua Tagovailoa throws 3 TD passes to rally the Dolphins past the Panthers 42-21

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence walked through the locker room and to the postgame podium without a limp or anything on his injured left knee.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars beat Minshew and the Colts 37-20 for their 9th consecutive home victory in the series

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Houston Texans

headlines.description: — After failing to get a late stop in a loss to the Falcons last week, the Houston Texans got two in the last five minutes on Sunday to secure a victory over the New Orleans Saints.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stroud throws 2 TD passes, defense makes late stops to lead Texans over Saints 20-13

events.name: New England Patriots at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Hanging over a game in which several ex-New England Patriots played key roles in a victory against their former team was the loss of Las Vegas Raiders quarterback Jimmy Garoppolo to a back injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders hold off Patriots 21-17 after losing QB Garoppolo to back injury

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Although the Los Angeles Rams have played plenty of stellar offensive football over the past seven seasons, Sean McVay's team hasn't usually done it by simply squaring its shoulders and running the ball straight through opposing defenses.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper Kupp, Kyren Williams score 2nd-half touchdowns in Rams' 26-9 win over Cardinals

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Robert Saleh stepped from the podium at his postgame news conference and let loose a little.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hall runs for a TD after Adams' INT and Jets shock Eagles 20-14 to send Philly to its first loss

events.name: Detroit Lions at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Jared Goff and the streaking Detroit Lions keep finding different ways to win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff throws for 353 yards, 2 TDs to lead NFC North-leading Lions past sputtering Buccaneers 20-6

events.name: New York Giants at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — It took Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills offense nearly three quarters to find their rhythm.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buffalo Bills hang on -- barely -- in a 14-9 win over the New York Giants

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Fans and some players might roll their eyes when a Week 6 game is described as a must win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak Prescott, Cowboys rally in fourth quarter for a 20-17 victory over the Chargers

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Jacksonville quarterback Trevor Lawrence was playing with a sprained left knee, and the visiting Jaguars hurt their own cause with turnovers and penalties.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Lawrence comes through late and the Jaguars hold off the Saints, 31-24

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — Nervous all week, Tyson Bagent didn't need much time to get comfortable. The butterflies went away after about the first snap.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Tyson Bagent leads 3 TD drives in place of Justin Fields, Bears beat Raiders 30-12

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Kareem Hunt and Myles Garrett flexed their muscles, P.J. Walker relied on true grit in place of Deshaun Watston and Dustin Hopkins' strong leg kept the Cleveland Browns kicking on all cylinders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kareem Hunt's late TD helps Browns rally past Colts 39-38 in topsy-turvy game

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — Bill Belichick will wait for another day to talk about the latest milestone win of his coaching career.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mac Jones' late TD pass lifts Patriots over Bills 29-25; Bill Belichick is 3rd coach with 300 wins

events.name: Washington Commanders at New York Giants

headlines.description: — The way the New York Giants have played defense the past few weeks, their inept offense can take the rest of the season to figure things out and coach Brian Daboll's team will still have a chance for more victories.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants defense stifles Commanders, makes late stand to end 4-game skid in 14-7 win

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Desmond Ridder and the mistake-prone Atlanta Falcons gave the Tampa Bay Buccaneers all kinds of opportunities to hang onto first place in the NFC South before showing why they believe they're a team headed in the right direction.
headlines.shortLinkText: Koo's game-ending 51-yard FG helps Falcons overcome Ridder's mistakes, beat Buccaneers 16-13

events.name: Detroit Lions at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — When Lamar Jackson returned to Baltimore to play for new offensive coordinator Todd Monken, this was pretty much the best-case scenario — the star quarterback finding open receivers deep in the secondary, scrambling when needed and guiding the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson almost flawless as Ravens rout Lions 38-6 in a matchup of division leaders

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Both the Steelers and the Rams knew their tight game wasn't solely decided by one questionable fourth-down spot at the two-minute warning.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers' offense awakens in fourth quarter, rallies for a 24-17 victory over the Rams

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Jake Bobo come from opposite ends of the spectrum for NFL rookies.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks get TDs from rookies Smith-Njigba, Bobo and rely on defense to topple Arizona 20-10

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — The end of Denver's dubious streak of blown halftime leads and the Broncos' first home victory under coach Sean Payton both came from the most unexpected of sources.
headlines.shortLinkText: P.J. Locke saves Denver from another second-half meltdown as Broncos beat Packers 19-17

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — If anybody should know how to stop Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce, it should probably be the Los Angeles Chargers and the rest of the AFC West, who get two cracks at beating the Kansas City Chiefs every season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws for 424 yards and 4 TDs, Kelce has big day as Chiefs beat Chargers 31-17

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Jalen Hurts needed a brace on his left leg in the second half — then shook off whatever ailed him to stand tall in the pocket and lead a go-ahead scoring drive — before he hobbled off the field after yet another Eagles win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurts passes for 279 yards, throws a TD and runs for one in Eagles' 31-17 win over Dolphins

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: — Kirk Cousins let the ball fly for Jordan Addison earlier than he wanted to in the face of an all-out San Francisco blitz in the closing seconds of the second quarter for Minnesota, bracing for the worst after realizing the pass was underthrown.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings outlast 49ers 22-17 with 2 Cousins-Addison TDs and 2 late interceptions by Bynum

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Low energy wasn’t going to be an issue for the slow-starting Buffalo Bills on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen gets Bills off to fast start in 24-18 win over Buccaneers

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott didn't lean on his defense quite so much this time.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott throws 4 TDs, Bland gets 3rd pick-6 of season as Cowboys rout Rams 43-20

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Kirk Cousins led the Minnesota Vikings back to relevance after their poor start to the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins throws 2 TD passes before leaving with injury in Vikings' 24-10 victory over Packers

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — The butterflies Tennessee Titans rookie quarterback Will Levis felt over the past two weeks disappeared Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Will Levis throws 4 TDs in his NFL debut as Titans beat Falcons 28-23

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — Derek Carr spent the past week answering questions about his sideline demeanor.
headlines.shortLinkText: Derek Carr rebounds from a tough week as the Saints beat the Colts 38-27

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — Tua Tagovailoa has never lost to New England coach Bill Belichick.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tua Tagovailoa throws for 3 TDs, Jalen Ramsey shines in debut for Dolphins, who beat Patriots 31-17

events.name: New York Jets at New York Giants

headlines.description: — For nearly 60 minutes, Zach Wilson and the New York Jets looked miserable on offense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets stun Giants late and earn ugly 13-10 overtime win on Zuerlein's field goal

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: — The Jacksonville Jaguars believe they can take their brand of football anywhere. Regardless of the continent. Regardless of the weather. Regardless of the opponent.
headlines.shortLinkText: Streaking Jaguars slug their way to 20-10 win over Pittsburgh as Steelers lose QB Pickett to injury

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Washington Commanders

headlines.description: — Walking gingerly back to the huddle after an early run, it was clear Jalen Hurts was hampered by his <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Hurts throws for 4 TDs on injured knee to help the Eagles beat the Commanders and improve to 7-1

events.name: Houston Texans at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: — Bryce Young has heard the criticism, the suggestion that Carolina made the wrong choice by taking him No. 1 overall instead of C.J. Stroud, who has put up big numbers for Houston.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryce Young beats C.J. Stroud as Panthers claim first victory of season over Texans 15-13

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — Jamal Adams used his head to give Geno Smith the chance at some late heroics that helped vault the Seattle Seahawks into first place in the NFC West.
headlines.shortLinkText: Geno Smith throws late TD pass to Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Seahawks top Browns 24-20

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: — Justin Simmons never paid much attention to the Broncos' long losing streak to the Kansas City Chiefs or the way Patrick Mahomes had owned them ever since winning in Denver in his first NFL start back in 2017.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson, Simmons lead Denver Broncos to first win over Chiefs since 2015 with a 24-9 thrashing

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Baltimore gave up a touchdown right out of the gate and two more in the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gus Edwards runs for 3 touchdowns, Ravens' defense keys 31-24 win over Cardinals

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: — Joe Burrow set the tone early when he ducked out of two sack attempts, scrambled away and converted a third-down pass that extended a game-opening touchdown drive for Cincinnati.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burrow throws 3 TD passes to lead the Bengals past the 49ers 31-17

events.name: Chicago Bears at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Leading up to Sunday night, Brandon Staley was looking for his Los Angeles Chargers to have a game where they could put all three phases together.
headlines.shortLinkText: Herbert throws for 3 touchdowns, Chargers get back on track with 30-13 victory over Bears

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — The Detroit Lions can trace their turnaround to hitting more than missing in the draft.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions lean on Jahmyr Gibbs' legs, Jared Goff's arm in 26-14 win over offensively challenged Raiders
